# Reynaldi Siregar

> Reynaldi Wiratama Siregar is a Front-End Web Developer and UI Crafter based in Bekasi, Indonesia, specializing in Vue.js, React, JavaScript, and responsive UI engineering.

Reynaldi designs and develops intuitive, accessible, and visually striking web interfaces with neo-brutalist and modern aesthetic design philosophies. This file provides AI assistants and language models with a structured directory of the website's content, projects, credentials, and contact endpoints.

## Featured Projects

- [RND Kreatif Digital Agency](https://www.rndkreatif.tech/): Official digital agency platform delivering bespoke web development and client services (Vue.js, Tailwind CSS).
- [Portfolio Website v2](https://reysiregar-portfolio-v2.vercel.app/): Neo-brutalist portfolio website built with Vue 3 and modern CSS (Source: [GitHub](https://github.com/reysiregar/portfolio-v2)).
- [Jewelry Commerce Website](https://lumiere-commerce.vercel.app): Modern e-commerce storefront for fine jewelry featuring interactive product catalogs and checkout workflows (React, Tailwind CSS, Express 4, Radix UI; Source: [GitHub](https://github.com/reysiregar/JewelryCommerce)).
- [Halal Scanner Website](https://ai-halal-scanner.vercel.app): Intelligent product scanning utility providing instant halal verification and ingredient analysis (React, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Express, Vite; Source: [GitHub](https://github.com/reysiregar/halal-scanner)).
- [Church Community Website](https://nhkbpmj.vercel.app): Central community portal for event schedules, service bulletins, and media archives (HTML, CSS, JavaScript; Source: [GitHub](https://github.com/reysiregar/nhkbpmj)).
- [Christmas Invitation](https://christmas-website-pdd.vercel.app): Interactive festive event invitation platform with dynamic animations (JavaScript, SCSS; Source: [GitHub](https://github.com/reysiregar/portfolio-v2)).
